questions.q: What is a cash advance in Oracle Fusion Expenses primarily meant to cover?
options: Airfare and hotel bookings
An employee's regular salary
Genuinely upfront, hard-to-predict incidental costs like tips or local transportation
Corporate card annual fees
questions.explain: Cash advances cover unpredictable incidental costs, not large planned costs that are booked directly or through a corporate card ahead of time.

questions.q: How does Castellan actually pay an approved cash advance to the employee?
options: Through Oracle Fusion Payables, as a standalone payment
By mailing physical cash
It is automatically deducted from the General Ledger with no payment
Advances are never actually paid, only promised
questions.explain: Once approved, the advance is paid through Payables using the same payment infrastructure used for expense reimbursements.

questions.q: At what level does a cash advance get applied against an expense report?
options: Only against a single specified expense line
It applies automatically to every future report forever
Cash advances cannot be applied to expense reports at all
At the expense report (header) level, not against individual lines
questions.explain: Cash advances apply at the expense report level — there is no way to designate that an advance covers only one specific line item.

questions.q: What happens if an employee receives a $600 cash advance but only incurs $410 in qualifying expenses?
options: The company simply forgives the $190 difference with no further action
The expense report still nets against the full advance, and the employee owes the $190 difference back
The employee's manager personally pays the difference
The advance is automatically doubled
questions.explain: The full advance amount nets against the report total, producing a negative net amount that the employee owes back through payroll, a future reimbursement, or manual repayment.

questions.q: What must an employee do if they choose NOT to apply an outstanding cash advance to a new expense report?
options: Type a justification explaining why no advance was applied
Nothing; it happens silently with no record
Cancel the entire expense report
Automatically forfeit the advance
questions.explain: Choosing 'Don't apply a cash advance' requires entering a justification, such as the advance being tied to a different, still-upcoming trip.
